summary: Iter 295 verified end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass for GET /api/tasks/director-digest-preview covering admin eligible+global, non-director ineligible, campus scoping (director w/ location_ids=['loc_002'] sees only loc_002 task while admin sees all 3), days-late DESC sort (5d>3d>1d), and regression sanity on /api/tasks, /api/finance/receipts/review-queue, /api/reports/pdf, /api/hr/payslips/generate-payday, /api/bank/accounts, /api/finance/journal. Frontend @ 390x844: DirectorDigestWidget renders on /dashboard with data-testid, count badge, view-all button, and correct 08:00 UTC copy. TabsList on /members (scrollW 376 > clientW 318, 3 tabs), /hr (716>318, 10 tabs, +md:flex-wrap preserved), /sales (412>334, 5 tabs) all have overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar with md:inline-flex escape hatch — horizontal scrolling works, no overlap.
action_items: A stale overdue task titled 'iter295 digest test task' is still in the DB from prior verification (agent note claimed cleanup but dashboard shows it in the digest count=1). Not blocking, but should be removed to keep admin dashboard clean.

The LiveCheckpointWidget was not present in DOM during the 390x844 dashboard load (likely conditional on active checkpoint) — order between LiveCheckpointWidget and DirectorDigestWidget was source-verified in DashboardPage.jsx lines 376 vs 381 (digest is after live checkpoint) but not runtime-verified because live-checkpoint rendered null in the test env.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/tasks.py `director_digest_preview` uses `date.today()` (server local TZ) — same inconsistency called out in iter294 review. For alignment with the 08:00 UTC scheduler use `datetime.now(timezone.utc).date().isoformat()`.
DIRECTOR_ROLES / GLOBAL_ROLES sets are duplicated inline in routers/tasks.py and (implicitly) in server.py scheduler — extract to a single module (e.g. `roles.py`) to avoid drift.
DirectorDigestWidget polls only on mount — consider a 5-min refresh interval or WS invalidation so directors see new overdue tasks without a full reload.
backend/routers/tasks.py now 727 lines; the digest preview + task_director_digests concerns could move to a `routers/tasks_scheduler.py` module.

TabsList overflow pattern is now duplicated across UnifiedPeoplePage, HRPage, ProductsPage — same class string. Consider a small `<ScrollableTabsList>` wrapper to DRY and prevent regressions in future pages.
